limitations: CAD mass is a derived estimate, not a weighed assembly.
Per-solid geometry mass calculation does not apply the displayed print infill setting.
Internal motor geometry is excluded where the 52 g specification already accounts for it.
Unmodeled electronics, wiring, connector adapters and battery mount add mass.
Battery dimensions, mass and capacity are catalog values; internal resistance, discharge curve and sag remain unmeasured.
Current battery-chain simulation is a separate hypothetical 2 Ah electrical scenario; it does not include the candidate battery body mass or inertia.
No purchase, mass change or automatic battery selection was performed.
